title: Sector Reversal: Does Removing the Market Help?
status: Specification saved before first signal calculation or strategy performance inspection on 2026-10-26. Literature-informed retrospective study, not a prospective live test.
question: Does sector-specific market-beta adjustment improve a five-session reversal signal after next-open entry?
beta_fit: OLS slope with intercept from 126 daily close-to-close log returns ending at t-5 inclusive; beta only is used to remove the five-session SPY move. Do not subtract fitted alpha or normalize scores.
signal_time: Last observed session of each ISO calendar week, after the close; only completed weeks with a following session are eligible.
entry: Following session's adjusted-open reference; no signal-close fill.
exit: Following weekly rebalance's adjusted-open reference; exclude holding periods crossing development/evaluation boundaries or ending after 2025-12-31. No forced partial final week.
portfolio: Buy lowest three scores and short highest three, each absolute weight 1/6; target gross notional USD 100000 every week. Ties resolved by symbol. Two strategies only: raw_reversal and market_adjusted_reversal.
account: Fixed-notional research PnL using adjusted-price units, not a brokerage share/cash simulation. Current weights are dollar-neutral at each entry, not guaranteed beta-neutral. No compounding of target notional, no leverage optimization, no interest income or margin model.
turnover: Sum abs(new target dollar exposure minus previous holdings marked at current adjusted-open reference), divided by fixed notional. Net unchanged holdings; start each reporting period flat and liquidate at its final exit, charging final turnover.
borrow_model: Short entry exposure times assumed 1% annual rate times actual calendar days/365; no verified historical borrow availability, recalls, or rates. Adjusted returns proxy distributions owed/received.
primary_comparison: Paired weekly net PnL per fixed notional: market_adjusted_reversal minus raw_reversal, at 5 bps one-way turnover cost and 1% annual borrow.
secondary: Turnover and break-even one-way cost after borrow
Signal-close to next-open diagnostic return excluded from strategy PnL
uncertainty: Paired moving-block bootstrap of evaluation weekly differences, four-week blocks, 5000 draws, seed 260126. Annualize mean by 52; interval is conditional/descriptive with only four evaluation years. Also report each year and leave-one-year-out mean differences.
no_tuning: No grid search, optimized sector count, horizon, threshold or regime filter. Opposite-sign momentum is not an independent test. Development and evaluation are displayed separately; all coefficients use only earlier observations.
limitations: Fixed ETF universe and provider-revised history, not a survivorship-free stock panel
Sector definitions and holdings change, including 2024 index-methodology updates
Adjusted open is raw open multiplied by same-day adjusted-close/close ratio, a total-return proxy rather than executable price
No spread, depth, impact, auction access or borrow observations
Weekly sectors are dependent; each week is one portfolio observation
Synthetic cash PnL is not realized trading performance
stop_condition: Two specified signals, chronological backtest, meaningful correctness tests, paired uncertainty and clear negative or positive findings. Do not retune to force profitability.
